content.comment_body: To configure the VW's, set the relevant Modbus properties. Does anyone know of a good Modbus simulator?
There are no free Modbus simulators that I used. I haven't tried any paid options. For basic tests, I use the Generic Tester from Schneider Electronics. [url]
I performed some tests but encountered only errors. I’ve attached a screenshot of the [product_name] program and its settings.
I also tried configuring the connection in network project mode but don't fully understand the client and server logic.
I recorded a screen video for you, but it was too large to attach in one file. So, I created a ZIP archive split into two parts. Here is part one.

Here is part two. After downloading, you need to rename part two from 'Modbus Test with Schneider Generic Tester.z01.zip' to 'Modbus Test with Schneider Generic Tester.z01'. Files with the .z01 extension can't be attached, so I changed the extension to .zip.
That was very useful. Thank you.

Hi [user_name], I noticed that the screenshots in the manuals differ from the current version of [product_name] Soft Comfort. More options now appear on the Modbus/S7 connections page after recent upgrades. Could you ask our colleagues at [company_name] to update the manuals for future releases?

I appreciate the suggestion, but I don't have a special relationship with [company_name]. Like you, I'm a regular user who happened to receive expert status from moderation. Therefore, I can't influence what [company_name] decides to publish.
Hello [user_name], there’s a feedback button on the Service & Support document pages. You can use that to let [company_name] know about outdated documents. Regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are looking for a reliable Modbus simulator to test [product_name] as a Modbus server. They struggle with configuration, especially in network project mode and understanding client/server dynamics. Errors during setup and unclear or outdated manuals from [company_name] add to the confusion, which is heightened by changes from software upgrades.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect updated documentation that matches the current software interface and clear, easy-to-follow instructions for configuring Modbus server functions on [product_name].
